issue_request: FHIR-12520 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core-search change request for DSTU2 asking to clarify _include wildcard handling, fix a duplicated-word typo, correct Bundle.entry.status to Bundle.entry.search.mode for included results, and state that absent or unretrievable include targets are omitted without a 404/error.
initial_application: SVN revision 11226, now git commit 1e8d3ba8d2706c6ca91643ee60a17e47f7c17048, applied the seed by changing the include-result paragraph to Bundle.entry.search.mode, adding no-error omission behavior for missing references, and fixing the reported duplicated-word typo. The current source still reflects those changes.
additional_context: source/search.html is active through source/hierarchy.xml under RESTful API. Later Published issues explain current differences from the original DSTU2 examples: FHIR-13602 changed :recurse to :iterate, FHIR-24888 added _include=* and _revinclude=* support, and FHIR-33309 clarified wildcard scope to search parameters supported for _include/_revinclude. Seed-specific Zulip and Confluence searches found no contrary community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the latest combined branch already satisfies the seed request. A source edit would either duplicate existing guidance or risk undoing later approved semantics.
